The '''Minister of Logistics''' was the title of an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial Sith]] bureaucrat that existed during the era of the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and [[Galactic War]].

==Known Ministers of Logistics==
*[[Shullis Khamarr]] ([[3660 BBY]]&mdash;?)<ref name="BoS:SftDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>
*[[Davidge]] ([[3640 BBY]])<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>
*[[Gelmid Lorman]] (?&mdash;[[3630 BBY]])
